parent_objective: One explicit deployment-wide PQC on/off policy across new QOMM, OCLOB and DeFMI deployments, including private distributed proofs and commitments. The user explicitly excludes migration of existing ledgers.
objective: Run the complete native-v2 public DvP fill/no-fill proof path on a fresh five-validator DeFMI chain whose new genesis format fixes the shared PQC On deployment policy, with mode-bound authority and full pending/final restart recovery.
bottleneck: The passing live007 chain used implicit legacy genesis/authority behavior. Its explicit coCode-v2 proof policy was not yet governed by the shared DeploymentCryptoPolicy at fresh genesis and restart.
whole_candidate: Create fresh QOMMGEN3 genesis with a strict shared On policy. Reuse only frozen public native-v2 input proofs as a functional comparison fixture, never a prior ledger/snapshot. Execute all real policy, book, proof-upload and commit transactions under the genesis-bound authority, require all five nodes to return the exact policy, and restart before pending proof commit and after both final commits.
truth_provider: Actual five AvalancheGo-hosted VM policy/accepted-transaction/state-root RPCs and both real validator restarts, with explicit canonical policy and proof-protocol readback.
likely_prediction_error: A legacy genesis, authority, state-sync or RPC path omits the shared policy and therefore refuses or incorrectly accepts an otherwise valid proof transition.
preflight: The explicit integration-live-greenfield entry point checks this contract and manifest hashes, typed strict policy, exact genesis policy, frozen native proof hashes and receipt, then atomically claims a fresh output and launches the isolated network.
postflight: Require every original live proof and restart gate plus exact policy equality in canonical and five-node evidence. Bind source, binary and public input hashes and append exactly one verdict without rewriting earlier runs.
rejection_rule: Policy mismatch or omission, legacy/classical proof bypass under On, missing real proof execution or either restart, unequal roots, changed proof/transport bounds or importing/mutating an existing ledger blocks completion.
promotion_rule: At most smoke_only. This is the first greenfield whole-path slice, not Off-mode venue equivalence, QOMM/OCLOB lifecycle adoption, independent operators, protected custody, formal composition/QROM validation or production promotion. Public development governance keys remain explicit lab fixtures although their signatures are already hybrid.
